proofUses.reason: Absolute moments justify both quotient derivatives and the signed moment formula.
The completed bootstrap gives the uniform comparison on p_c/2 <= p < p_c; the dimension factor and zero endpoint are explicit.
The second moment proves the little-oh asymptotic. A power remainder is conditional on an absolute higher moment.
The conditional tilted identity places squared mass on the inverse-susceptibility side. Identifying the mass and proving the tilted estimates remain separate.
The finite-box first-exit kernel gives an exponential moment, then weighted norm continuity controls the supremum.
The positive Fourier gap and d>2 justify absolute Fubini even when the spatial kernel is signed.
